source: eBird Status and Trends relative abundance (weekly, median), Cornell Lab of Ornithology; species in the genera used by Gonnerman et al. 2025; goose = Anser, Branta, Coscoroba, Cygnus; duck = the other genera; sampled to a regular grid
order: week 1..52, then rows north to south, then columns west to east; all waterfowl = goose + duck
